title: E2E tests: Full proxy pipeline with mock server
description: Add end-to-end tests using a mock upstream server. Tests: 1) Request flows through proxy unchanged (passthrough) 2) X-Provider routing selects correct upstream 3) Context injection modifies request 4) Streaming SSE chunks are forwarded correctly 5) Non-streaming responses work 6) Error responses are forwarded 7) Conversation state is tracked 8) Logging captures request/response. Use wiremock or similar for mock server.

Tests: 1) OpenAI -> Anthropic -> OpenAI round-trip preserves content 2) Tool calls transform correctly (ID format differences) 3) Thinking blocks convert to <thinking> tags when crossing providers 4) System messages handled correctly per provider 5) Multi-turn conversations maintain context 6) Image/vision content transforms (base64, URLs) 7) Streaming events map correctly between formats

title: Stress tests: Concurrent connections and streaming
description: Add stress/load tests for the proxy. Tests: 1) 100 concurrent non-streaming requests 2) 50 concurrent streaming connections 3) Long-running streams (5+ minutes) 4) Rapid connect/disconnect cycles 5) Memory usage under load (no leaks) 6) Injection during active streams 7) Provider failover scenarios. Use criterion for benchmarks, tokio-test for async.

title: CLI test harness for manual provider testing

Features: 1) eavs-test chat 'Hello' --provider anthropic 2) eavs-test stream 'Tell me a story' --provider ollama 3) eavs-test image path/to/image.png 'Describe this' 4) eavs-test tool-call --provider openai 5) Output shows: request sent, response received, timing, token usage. Could be a separate binary or a cargo xtask.

title: Add vision/multimodal support for image inputs

Design: 1) Parse OpenAI vision format (image_url with base64 or URL) 2) Transform to provider-specific formats (Anthropic uses source.data, Google uses inlineData) 3) Handle both base64 and URL inputs 4) Support image content blocks in messages array. This enables ingestr VLM processing via EAVS.
